repeats.line: "Here's what it would take, if you want more than this: show up when it costs you something. That's the whole test."

repeats.line: "So." They look at the fire for a moment.

repeats.line: "I sharpen sticks down to nothing. It doesn't bring anyone back. It just keeps my hands from shaking."

repeats.name: Valeria
repeats.line: They nod, slow. "Okay. Thank you for telling me. That couldn't have been easy to say."

repeats.name: Valeria
repeats.line: "Good. Anger's fuel. Just — point it somewhere useful."

repeats.line: "I keep turning over the last thing Caleb said to me. I can't tell if I'm remembering it right, and that's somehow the worst part."

repeats.line: "I used to think worse of Daniyar. The scattering has a way of... editing people. Mostly for the better. Mostly."

repeats.name: Sofia
